capability_check.summary: Checked both entries in the service catalog against the proposed digital expense-claim capability; the closest candidate is SVC-HR-001 (HR & Payroll).
capability_check.rationale: SVC-HR-001 runs scheduled payroll and holds core HR records; it has no ad-hoc expense-claim submission or approval workflow of any kind. SVC-ID-001 is identity-only, not a candidate at all. No duplicate-build risk found.

existing_system_impact.how_or_why_not: Outbound integration — an approved claim is submitted into the next payroll run for payment; the payroll system is not queried or modified beyond receiving that submission.
Required — every user of this tool is an existing employee, so authentication reuses the group SSO directly rather than needing a separate identity tier.

components.rationale: Isolated intake step; independently deployable, nothing else depends on its internals.
The payroll-submission integration depends on its approval decision, so it is not fully isolated, but it is not compliance/legal-critical.
Reporting-only; not on the critical path of a claim's approval or payment.
